title: EEG Resting-state Microstates Correlates of Executive Functions
description: This dataset comprises resting-state EEG recordings and behavioral executive function assessments from 140 healthy adult participants, collected to investigate the relationship between intrinsic brain spatio-temporal dynamics (via EEG microstates) and executive functions. Participants underwent a 5-minute resting-state EEG recording (eyes open/closed) followed by a battery of nine cognitive tasks assessing executive functions. The study aimed to correlate EEG microstate metrics (occurrence, duration) with executive function performance scores.
methods_description: Resting-state EEG was recorded using a 64-electrode Biosemi Active-two amplifier at 512 Hz during a 5-minute session alternating between 30-second blocks of eyes closed and eyes open. In a separate session, participants completed nine cognitive tasks (antisaccade, letter-memory, color-shape, number-letter, Stroop, keep track, dual n-back, category switch, stop-signal) to assess executive functions. Data were collected at the Centre de Neuroergonomie at ISAE-SUPAERO (Toulouse, France) between February 2022 and July 2023.
